proposed.explanation: To compare the companies on their price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio and make a fully informed recommendation, we need the number of shares or market capitalization values, or explicit P/E figures. While net profits and earnings per share are available, calculating the P/E ratio requires share prices alongside earnings per share or total market data. Therefore, the evidence is insufficient to complete the P/E comparison required by the user.
limitations: P/E ratios cannot be directly calculated or compared without additional market valuation inputs or explicit figures.
This guidance is based strictly on the provided financial reports and cutoff date prices.
